2-pfmerge.b'summary': Merges one or more HyperLogLog values into a single key.
2-pfmerge.b'complexity': O(N) to merge N HyperLogLogs, but with high constant times.

2-replicaof.b'summary': Configures a server as replica of another, or promotes it to a master.

2-flushall.b'summary': Removes all keys from all databases.
2-flushall.b'complexity': O(N) where N is the total number of keys in all databases

2-unlink.b'summary': Asynchronously deletes one or more keys.
2-unlink.b'complexity': O(1) for each key removed regardless of its size. Then the command does O(N) work in a different thread in order to reclaim memory, where N is the number of allocations the deleted objects where composed of.

2-renamenx.b'summary': Renames a key only when the target key name doesn't exist.
b'history': The command no longer returns an error when source and destination names are the same.

2-zremrangebyscore.b'summary': Removes members in a sorted set within a range of scores. Deletes the sorted set if all members were removed.
2-zremrangebyscore.b'complexity': O(log(N)+M) with N being the number of elements in the sorted set and M the number of elements removed by the operation.

2-hmget.b'summary': Returns the values of all fields in a hash.
2-hmget.b'complexity': O(N) where N is the number of fields being requested.

2-psubscribe.b'summary': Listens for messages published to channels that match one or more patterns.
2-psubscribe.b'complexity': O(N) where N is the number of patterns to subscribe to.

2-xlen.b'summary': Return the number of messages in a stream.

2-hpttl.b'summary': Returns the TTL in milliseconds of a hash field.
2-hpttl.b'complexity': O(N) where N is the number of specified fields

2-sinterstore.b'summary': Stores the intersect of multiple sets in a key.
2-sinterstore.b'complexity': O(N*M) worst case where N is the cardinality of the smallest set and M is the number of sets.

2-bgrewriteaof.b'summary': Asynchronously rewrites the append-only file to disk.

2-sismember.b'summary': Determines whether a member belongs to a set.

2-lindex.b'summary': Returns an element from a list by its index.
2-lindex.b'complexity': O(N) where N is the number of elements to traverse to get to the element at index. This makes asking for the first or the last element of the list O(1).

2-zrandmember.b'summary': Returns one or more random members from a sorted set.
2-zrandmember.b'complexity': O(N) where N is the number of members returned

2-wait.b'summary': Blocks until the asynchronous replication of all preceding write commands sent by the connection is completed.

2-spublish.b'summary': Post a message to a shard channel
2-spublish.b'complexity': O(N) where N is the number of clients subscribed to the receiving shard channel.

2-restore.b'summary': Creates a key from the serialized representation of a value.
2-restore.b'complexity': O(1) to create the new key and additional O(N*M) to reconstruct the serialized value, where N is the number of Redis objects composing the value and M their average size. For small string values the time complexity is thus O(1)+O(1*M) where M is small, so simply O(1). However for sorted set values the complexity is O(N*M*log(N)) because inserting values into sorted sets is O(log(N)).

2-hkeys.b'summary': Returns all fields in a hash.
2-hkeys.b'complexity': O(N) where N is the size of the hash.

2-rename.b'summary': Renames a key and overwrites the destination.

2-geodist.b'summary': Returns the distance between two members of a geospatial index.

2-ltrim.b'summary': Removes elements from both ends a list. Deletes the list if all elements were trimmed.
2-ltrim.b'complexity': O(N) where N is the number of elements to be removed by the operation.

2-brpoplpush.b'summary': Pops an element from a list, pushes it to another list and returns it. Block until an element is available otherwise. Deletes the list if the last element was popped.
b'history': `timeout` is interpreted as a double instead of an integer.

2-strlen.b'summary': Returns the length of a string value.

2-restore-asking.b'summary': An internal command for migrating keys in a cluster.
2-restore-asking.b'complexity': O(1) to create the new key and additional O(N*M) to reconstruct the serialized value, where N is the number of Redis objects composing the value and M their average size. For small string values the time complexity is thus O(1)+O(1*M) where M is small, so simply O(1). However for sorted set values the complexity is O(N*M*log(N)) because inserting values into sorted sets is O(log(N)).

2-monitor.b'summary': Listens for all requests received by the server in real-time.

2-sadd.b'summary': Adds one or more members to a set. Creates the key if it doesn't exist.
2-sadd.b'complexity': O(1) for each element added, so O(N) to add N elements when the command is called with multiple arguments.

2-set.b'summary': Sets the string value of a key, ignoring its type. The key is created if it doesn't exist.
b'history': Allowed the `NX` and `GET` options to be used together.

2-zincrby.b'summary': Increments the score of a member in a sorted set.
2-zincrby.b'complexity': O(log(N)) where N is the number of elements in the sorted set.

2-sdiffstore.b'summary': Stores the difference of multiple sets in a key.
2-sdiffstore.b'complexity': O(N) where N is the total number of elements in all given sets.

2-sunionstore.b'summary': Stores the union of multiple sets in a key.
2-sunionstore.b'complexity': O(N) where N is the total number of elements in all given sets.

2-randomkey.b'summary': Returns a random key name from the database.

2-xrange.b'summary': Returns the messages from a stream within a range of IDs.
2-xrange.b'complexity': O(N) with N being the number of elements being returned. If N is constant (e.g. always asking for the first 10 elements with COUNT), you can consider it O(1).

2-scard.b'summary': Returns the number of members in a set.

2-zrangebyscore.b'summary': Returns members in a sorted set within a range of scores.
2-zrangebyscore.b'complexity': O(log(N)+M) with N being the number of elements in the sorted set and M the number of elements being returned. If M is constant (e.g. always asking for the first 10 elements with LIMIT), you can consider it O(log(N)).

2-geosearch.b'summary': Queries a geospatial index for members inside an area of a box or a circle.
2-geosearch.b'complexity': O(N+log(M)) where N is the number of elements in the grid-aligned bounding box area around the shape provided as the filter and M is the number of items inside the shape
b'history': Added support for uppercase unit names.

2-pfdebug.b'summary': Internal commands for debugging HyperLogLog values.

2-bitfield.b'summary': Performs arbitrary bitfield integer operations on strings.

2-exists.b'summary': Determines whether one or more keys exist.
2-exists.b'complexity': O(N) where N is the number of keys to check.

2-xread.b'summary': Returns messages from multiple streams with IDs greater than the ones requested. Blocks until a message is available otherwise.

2-zrevrank.b'summary': Returns the index of a member in a sorted set ordered by descending scores.

2-append.b'summary': Appends a string to the value of a key. Creates the key if it doesn't exist.
2-append.b'complexity': O(1). The amortized time complexity is O(1) assuming the appended value is small and the already present value is of any size, since the dynamic string library used by Redis will double the free space available on every reallocation.

2-unwatch.b'summary': Forgets about watched keys of a transaction.

2-zunionstore.b'summary': Stores the union of multiple sorted sets in a key.
2-zunionstore.b'complexity': O(N)+O(M log(M)) with N being the sum of the sizes of the input sorted sets, and M being the number of elements in the resulting sorted set.

2-get.b'summary': Returns the string value of a key.

2-hstrlen.b'summary': Returns the length of the value of a field.

2-hexpire.b'summary': Set expiry for hash field using relative time to expire (seconds)
2-hexpire.b'complexity': O(N) where N is the number of specified fields

2-persist.b'summary': Removes the expiration time of a key.

2-ssubscribe.b'summary': Listens for messages published to shard channels.
2-ssubscribe.b'complexity': O(N) where N is the number of shard channels to subscribe to.

2-sinter.b'summary': Returns the intersect of multiple sets.
2-sinter.b'complexity': O(N*M) worst case where N is the cardinality of the smallest set and M is the number of sets.

2-zrevrangebylex.b'summary': Returns members in a sorted set within a lexicographical range in reverse order.
2-zrevrangebylex.b'complexity': O(log(N)+M) with N being the number of elements in the sorted set and M the number of elements being returned. If M is constant (e.g. always asking for the first 10 elements with LIMIT), you can consider it O(log(N)).

2-hscan.b'summary': Iterates over fields and values of a hash.
2-hscan.b'complexity': O(1) for every call. O(N) for a complete iteration, including enough command calls for the cursor to return back to 0. N is the number of elements inside the collection.

2-georadius_ro.b'summary': Returns members from a geospatial index that are within a distance from a coordinate.
2-georadius_ro.b'complexity': O(N+log(M)) where N is the number of elements inside the bounding box of the circular area delimited by center and radius and M is the number of items inside the index.
b'history': Added support for uppercase unit names.

2-georadiusbymember_ro.b'summary': Returns members from a geospatial index that are within a distance from a member.
2-georadiusbymember_ro.b'complexity': O(N+log(M)) where N is the number of elements inside the bounding box of the circular area delimited by center and radius and M is the number of items inside the index.
b'history': Added support for uppercase unit names.

2-hpexpire.b'summary': Set expiry for hash field using relative time to expire (milliseconds)
2-hpexpire.b'complexity': O(N) where N is the number of specified fields

2-lrange.b'summary': Returns a range of elements from a list.
2-lrange.b'complexity': O(S+N) where S is the distance of start offset from HEAD for small lists, from nearest end (HEAD or TAIL) for large lists; and N is the number of elements in the specified range.

2-fcall_ro.b'complexity': Depends on the function that is executed.

2-exec.b'summary': Executes all commands in a transaction.
2-exec.b'complexity': Depends on commands in the transaction

2-slaveof.b'summary': Sets a Redis server as a replica of another, or promotes it to being a master.

2-del.b'complexity': O(N) where N is the number of keys that will be removed. When a key to remove holds a value other than a string, the individual complexity for this key is O(M) where M is the number of elements in the list, set, sorted set or hash. Removing a single key that holds a string value is O(1).

b'module|loadex'.b'summary': Loads a module using extended parameters.

b'module|list'.b'complexity': O(N) where N is the number of loaded modules.

2-substr.b'summary': Returns a substring from a string value.

2-eval.b'complexity': Depends on the script that is executed.

2-llen.b'summary': Returns the length of a list.

2-getex.b'summary': Returns the string value of a key after setting its expiration time.

2-geoadd.b'summary': Adds one or more members to a geospatial index. The key is created if it doesn't exist.
2-geoadd.b'complexity': O(log(N)) for each item added, where N is the number of elements in the sorted set.

2-mset.b'summary': Atomically creates or modifies the string values of one or more keys.
2-mset.b'complexity': O(N) where N is the number of keys to set.

2-xclaim.b'summary': Changes, or acquires, ownership of a message in a consumer group, as if the message was delivered a consumer group member.

b'cluster|setslot'.b'summary': Binds a hash slot to a node.

b'cluster|forget'.b'summary': Removes a node from the nodes table.

b'cluster|shards'.b'summary': Returns the mapping of cluster slots to shards.
b'cluster|shards'.b'complexity': O(N) where N is the total number of cluster nodes

b'cluster|delslots'.b'summary': Sets hash slots as unbound for a node.
b'cluster|delslots'.b'complexity': O(N) where N is the total number of hash slot arguments

b'cluster|getkeysinslot'.b'summary': Returns the key names in a hash slot.
b'cluster|getkeysinslot'.b'complexity': O(N) where N is the number of requested keys

b'cluster|reset'.b'complexity': O(N) where N is the number of known nodes. The command may execute a FLUSHALL as a side effect.

b'cluster|set-config-epoch'.b'summary': Sets the configuration epoch for a new node.

b'cluster|addslots'.b'summary': Assigns new hash slots to a node.
b'cluster|addslots'.b'complexity': O(N) where N is the total number of hash slot arguments

b'cluster|slaves'.b'summary': Lists the replica nodes of a master node.
b'cluster|slaves'.b'complexity': O(N) where N is the number of replicas.

b'cluster|delslotsrange'.b'summary': Sets hash slot ranges as unbound for a node.
b'cluster|delslotsrange'.b'complexity': O(N) where N is the total number of the slots between the start slot and end slot arguments.

b'cluster|replicate'.b'summary': Configure a node as replica of a master node.

b'cluster|myshardid'.b'summary': Returns the shard ID of a node.

b'cluster|flushslots'.b'summary': Deletes all slots information from a node.

b'cluster|failover'.b'summary': Forces a replica to perform a manual failover of its master.

b'cluster|info'.b'summary': Returns information about the state of a node.

b'cluster|myid'.b'summary': Returns the ID of a node.

b'cluster|keyslot'.b'summary': Returns the hash slot for a key.

3-save.b'summary': Synchronously saves the database(s) to disk.
3-save.b'complexity': O(N) where N is the total number of keys in all databases

3-psync.b'summary': An internal command used in replication.

3-hincrbyfloat.b'summary': Increments the floating point value of a field by a number. Uses 0 as initial value if the field doesn't exist.

3-lpop.b'summary': Returns the first elements in a list after removing it. Deletes the list if the last element was popped.
3-lpop.b'complexity': O(N) where N is the number of elements returned

3-bzmpop.b'summary': Removes and returns a member by score from one or more sorted sets. Blocks until a member is available otherwise. Deletes the sorted set if the last element was popped.
3-bzmpop.b'complexity': O(K) + O(M*log(N)) where K is the number of provided keys, N being the number of elements in the sorted set, and M being the number of elements popped.

3-georadius.b'summary': Queries a geospatial index for members within a distance from a coordinate, optionally stores the result.
3-georadius.b'complexity': O(N+log(M)) where N is the number of elements inside the bounding box of the circular area delimited by center and radius and M is the number of items inside the index.
b'history': Added support for uppercase unit names.

3-getset.b'summary': Returns the previous string value of a key after setting it to a new value.

3-zmpop.b'summary': Returns the highest- or lowest-scoring members from one or more sorted sets after removing them. Deletes the sorted set if the last member was popped.
3-zmpop.b'complexity': O(K) + O(M*log(N)) where K is the number of provided keys, N being the number of elements in the sorted set, and M being the number of elements popped.

3-httl.b'summary': Returns the TTL in seconds of a hash field.
3-httl.b'complexity': O(N) where N is the number of specified fields

3-hpersist.b'summary': Removes the expiration time for each specified field
3-hpersist.b'complexity': O(N) where N is the number of specified fields

3-rpush.b'summary': Appends one or more elements to a list. Creates the key if it doesn't exist.
3-rpush.b'complexity': O(1) for each element added, so O(N) to add N elements when the command is called with multiple arguments.

3-hget.b'summary': Returns the value of a field in a hash.

3-bitpos.b'summary': Finds the first set (1) or clear (0) bit in a string.

3-zscan.b'summary': Iterates over members and scores of a sorted set.
3-zscan.b'complexity': O(1) for every call. O(N) for a complete iteration, including enough command calls for the cursor to return back to 0. N is the number of elements inside the collection.

b'pubsub|help'.b'summary': Returns helpful text about the different subcommands.

b'pubsub|channels'.b'complexity': O(N) where N is the number of active channels, and assuming constant time pattern matching (relatively short channels and patterns)

b'pubsub|numpat'.b'summary': Returns a count of unique pattern subscriptions.

b'pubsub|shardchannels'.b'complexity': O(N) where N is the number of active shard channels, and assuming constant time pattern matching (relatively short shard channels).

b'pubsub|shardnumsub'.b'summary': Returns the count of subscribers of shard channels.
b'pubsub|shardnumsub'.b'complexity': O(N) for the SHARDNUMSUB subcommand, where N is the number of requested shard channels

b'pubsub|numsub'.b'summary': Returns a count of subscribers to channels.
b'pubsub|numsub'.b'complexity': O(N) for the NUMSUB subcommand, where N is the number of requested channels

3-zadd.b'summary': Adds one or more members to a sorted set, or updates their scores. Creates the key if it doesn't exist.
3-zadd.b'complexity': O(log(N)) for each item added, where N is the number of elements in the sorted set.

3-pexpiretime.b'summary': Returns the expiration time of a key as a Unix milliseconds timestamp.

3-swapdb.b'complexity': O(N) where N is the count of clients watching or blocking on keys from both databases.

3-linsert.b'summary': Inserts an element before or after another element in a list.
3-linsert.b'complexity': O(N) where N is the number of elements to traverse before seeing the value pivot. This means that inserting somewhere on the left end on the list (head) can be considered O(1) and inserting somewhere on the right end (tail) is O(N).

3-pfadd.b'summary': Adds elements to a HyperLogLog key. Creates the key if it doesn't exist.

3-type.b'summary': Determines the type of value stored at a key.

3-ttl.b'summary': Returns the expiration time in seconds of a key.

3-rpoplpush.b'summary': Returns the last element of a list after removing and pushing it to another list. Deletes the list if the last element was popped.

3-lastsave.b'summary': Returns the Unix timestamp of the last successful save to disk.
